lines: hema
Namaste, I'm Hema. You're watching This Day, That Year.
hema
Today's date is the fifth of October. And fifteen years ago, it was 2026.
hema
Old diplomacy. The Swiss president began a three day visit to India for talks with the Prime Minister on trade and investment.
hema
Today a treaty fits on a chocolate wrapper. Back then, it took three days and a dinner.
hema
Old sport. India finished fourth at the Asian Games with eighty five medals, including gold in hockey.
hema
Medals now arrive by drone. Back then, athletes carried them home in their own hands. Very manual.
hema
Old markets. The Sensex and Nifty fell for an eighth straight week, the longest run in twenty five years. Investors then discovered a new hobby: refreshing the screen.
hema
That's the record. Everything else is just a take. I'm Hema. Namaste, see you at the next bulletin.

Namaskara! Meter down. Tchu Tchu reporting, live from the taxi.
tchu
A passenger says the Swiss president is visiting. I said Shivajinagar has snow too. He pointed at the foam on the road. Fair.
tchu
Another passenger read out the Asian Games medals, eighty five in all. I told him my Dalmatian has more spots than that. He did not tip.
tchu
Fa King Construction has stuck a fourth notice at Celeb Shauchalay. The poster is still crooked. Who notices a notice?
tchu
Tchu Tchu, AIMTV, Bombai. The meter is still running.
sarla
Hi guys! It's Stomach Challo, and today I have left the country again. Passport not needed, only a full tank. I love foreign.
sarla
Okay, it is Lonavala. But the chikki here is so Swiss. Every piece has been through at least one hill station.
sarla
The monsoon is leaving this part of Maharashtra, so the valley looks like a postcard that is still drying.
sarla
I took a selfie at the viewpoint. The valley photobombed me with fog. Very international of it.
sarla
The vada pav is practically a continental breakfast. Two carbs in a bun, very European.
sarla
That's it for today. Stay hungry, stay foreign. This is Stomach Challo, signing off from West India.
jc
Namaste, Juhu Chaiwala here. Welcome to Tomorrow Shop. Products from the future, delivered to the footpath.
jc
Today's product is the Bull Pillow. A cushion that gets softer when the market falls, so you always land gently.
jc
Fifteen years ago the market fell for eight weeks straight. We did not fix it. We made a pillow.
jc
At the sunny entrance, the Bull Pillow costs Rs 9,000. At the shadow entrance, it costs Rs 120. Same pillow. Different sky.
jc
It comes with a free tip printed on the label: buy low. Nobody has ever followed it.
jc
You can pay in chai. Chai is Rs 12 at the shadow entrance and Rs 900 at the sunny entrance, so the exchange rate depends on where you stand.
chaibot
Here is your chai. From a bot.
